title: Sleepy seal
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id="g" cx="50%" cy="60%" r="60%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#4a6d8c"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#2c4257"/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="72" rx="36" ry="20" fill="url(#g)"/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="78" rx="24" ry="12" fill="#8fa8bd"/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d="M84 72 Q94 66 90 76 Q96 80 86 80 Z" fill="#3a5570"/>
  <!-- left flipper -->
  <path d="M22 66 Q12 76 20 82 Q28 80 30 72 Z" fill="#3a5570"/>
  <!-- right flipper -->
  <path d="M78 66 Q88 76 80 82 Q72 80 70 72 Z" fill="#3a5570"/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="42" rx="24" ry="22" fill="#5c83a3"/>
  <!-- snout/muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="52" rx="15" ry="11" fill="#a8bdcd"/>
  <!-- sleepy closed eyes -->
  <path d="M34 38 Q39 43 44 38" stroke="#2c4257" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M56 38 Q61 43 66 38" stroke="#2c4257" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- blush cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx="33" cy="47" rx="4" ry="2.5" fill="#e5a0a8"/>
  <ellipse cx="67" cy="47" rx="4" ry="2.5" fill="#e5a0a8"/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="48" rx="3.5" ry="2.5" fill="#2c4257"/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d="M46 54 Q50 57 54 54" stroke="#556b7d" stroke-width="1.6" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- whisker dots -->
  <circle cx="42" cy="53" r="0.9" fill="#6d8799"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="53" r="0.9" fill="#6d8799"/>
  <!-- sleep zzz -->
  <path d="M72 24 h6 l-6 6 h6" stroke="#9fd6ff" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <path d="M82 14 h4 l-4 4 h4" stroke="#7fc0ee" stroke-width="1.6" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
</svg>
